Amara Diallo 106  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 123 4567 | amara.diallo@lumina.games | linkedin.com/in/amara-diallo  

At Lumina Games, I’ve focused on streamlining infrastructure workflows to support scalable game development. My role involves designing systems that balance performance and cost, ensuring reliable deployments for high-traffic multiplayer games. I’ve led efforts to automate repetitive tasks, reduce manual intervention, and improve team collaboration across development, operations, and security teams. A key priority has been maintaining uptime during peak hours, which requires proactive monitoring and rapid response protocols.  

Prior to joining Lumina, I worked as a DevOps Engineer at PixelPulse Studios, where I contributed to migrating legacy systems to cloud-native architectures. This involved rearchitecting monolithic applications into microservices, implementing CI/CD pipelines for faster iteration cycles, and optimizing resource allocation to handle seasonal traffic spikes. I also collaborated with cross-functional teams to establish best practices for infrastructure as code, which reduced deployment errors by 30% over 18 months.  

My technical expertise centers on cloud-native tools and orchestration platforms. I’ve designed Kubernetes clusters that support dynamic scaling for live game servers, ensuring minimal latency during peak usage. I’ve also implemented Terraform to standardize environment provisioning, which cut setup time for new projects by half. Monitoring and alerting frameworks like Prometheus and Grafana are integral to my workflow, enabling real-time visibility into system health and performance trends.  

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Technology Sydney, 2015. Graduated with a focus on distributed systems and network protocols, which laid the foundation for my career in scalable infrastructure solutions.  

Key projects include:  
- **Global Server Cluster Optimization**: Redesigned regional server deployments to reduce latency for international players, improving user retention by 15% through strategic placement of game servers.  
- **Cost Efficiency Initiative**: Developed a cloud cost management framework that automated resource scaling and identified underutilized instances, resulting in a 22% reduction in monthly operational expenses.  
- **CI/CD Pipeline Overhaul**: Refactored existing workflows to integrate automated testing and rollback mechanisms, decreasing deployment-related downtime by 40% across multiple titles.  

Fluent in English and Hebrew.  

Recognized for contributions to team efficiency and system reliability, including a 2021 internal award for reducing incident resolution time by 25% through improved monitoring practices. Also, led a cross-team effort to document operational procedures, which streamlined onboarding for new engineers and reduced knowledge-sharing bottlenecks.
